summary: Zach Jones, 33, of Creede went missing at ~12:40 p.m. Thursday after his raft overturned in the Rio Grande River; the two others aboard were safe. Searchers worked the river in rafts and on the banks with drone support; the river was closed to boating on Friday as the search continued.
notes: 'assist' follows index convention for unresolved missing-person searches (cf. id 625); AP via Denver Post. Thursday was the first day the river was open to boaters after a closure for dangerous conditions; spokeswoman Stasha Rice; 2019-06-27 Thursday-verified. Miner 2019-06-28 follow-up documents continuing Rio Grande search (Zack Jones lead resolved run 624).
